summary_1line: Vaisampayana explains Duhsala’s birth from an extra fragment of Gandhari’s divided flesh and then lists the hundred Kaurava sons in order.

image_candidates.scene_text: Vyasa divides the strange lump of flesh while nurses place the pieces into pots of clarified butter as Gandhari watches anxiously.
The sage sets aside one final fragment in a separate pot, declaring it will become Gandhari’s daughter Duhsala.
